<reason>PRO won by making the motion’s own test the vote: science per dollar, applied to the few huge crewed architectures that actually absorb exploration money. CON was more careful on “most,” option value, and incomplete rebuilding accounting, but after conceding no deep-space crewed mission beats probes on that metric, the residual goods never clearly entitled crews to most of the budget.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>PRO’s Q2 forced CON to admit they could not name a deep-space crewed mission that wins on science per dollar; PRO then used that concession to collapse “keep the capability” into a cadence veto against the majority shift.</best_rebuttal>
